Sankat Mochan Hanuman Ashtak — shri hanuman ashtak
A powerful devotional chant dedicated to Mahaveer Hanuman, the remover of obstacles and the giver of strength, courage, and protection.
The Hanuman Ashtak is one of the most potent prayers sung to seek blessings from Sankat Mochan, who destroys fear, negative energy, suffering, and difficulties from the life of devotees.
Why Listen to Hanuman Ashtak?
Protection from negative forces
Removes fear & mental stress
Brings courage, wisdom & strength
Gives relief from difficulties (Sankat)
